;;; drgnx-acp.el --- A small Agent Client Protocol client: JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON object per line -*- lexical-binding: t -*-

;; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later

;;; Commentary:
;; An ACP agent is a process speaking JSON-RPC 2.0 on its stdin/stdout, one object per line.  This
;; file is the transport: requests with callbacks, notifications both ways, and the agent's own
;; requests to us (permissions, file reads and writes) answered by a handler — immediately, or later
;; with `drgnx-acp-respond'.  Everything runs from process filters and sentinels: nothing here ever
;; waits or asks.  A malformed line is logged and skipped; when the agent exits, pending requests
;; fail and the handler hears the exit status with the end of its stderr.  See docs/guide/agents.md.

;;; Code:
(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'seq)
(require 'subr-x)
(require 'drgnx-paths)
(require 'drgnx-timer)
(require 'drgnx-guard)

(cl-defstruct (drgnx-acp-conn (:constructor drgnx-acp--make) (:copier nil))
  process stderr-process (next-id 0) (pending (make-hash-table :test #'eql)) input-buffer (stderr "")
  on-notification on-request on-exit log exited)

(defconst drgnx-acp--stderr-max 8000 "Characters of the agent's stderr kept.")
(defconst drgnx-acp--log-max 50 "Protocol problems kept (newest first).")

(defun drgnx-acp--note (conn fmt &rest args)
  (let ((l (cons (apply #'format fmt args) (drgnx-acp-conn-log conn))))
    (setf (drgnx-acp-conn-log conn) (seq-take l drgnx-acp--log-max))))

(defun drgnx-acp--send (conn obj)
  (let ((p (drgnx-acp-conn-process conn)))
    (if (process-live-p p)
        (process-send-string p (concat (json-serialize obj) "\n"))
      (drgnx-acp--note conn "not sent (agent gone): %s" (plist-get obj :method)))))

;;;; Input: framing and dispatch

(defun drgnx-acp--input-buffer (conn)
  (let ((b (drgnx-acp-conn-input-buffer conn)))
    (unless (buffer-live-p b)
      (setq b (generate-new-buffer " *drgnx-acp-input*"))
      (with-current-buffer b (set-buffer-multibyte t))
      (setf (drgnx-acp-conn-input-buffer conn) b))
    b))

(defun drgnx-acp--input (conn string)
  "Take STRING from the agent: every complete line is one message; the rest waits for more."

(require 'cl-lib)
(require 'subr-x)
(require 'drgnx-agent-config)

(defconst drgnx-agent-config-gemini--events
  '("BeforeTool" "AfterTool" "BeforeAgent" "AfterAgent" "Notification" "SessionStart" "SessionEnd" "PreCompress"
    "BeforeModel" "AfterModel" "BeforeToolSelection")
  "The hook events of gemini 0.64.0.")

(defvar drgnx-agent-config-gemini--texts nil
  "While reading: file name -> a buffer with its text without comments, for the line numbers of the items.")

;;;; Where the files are

(defun drgnx-agent-config-gemini--system-file (name variable)
  "The system file NAME: the file the environment VARIABLE names, else the platform's own directory."
  (or (drgnx-agent-config--env-dir variable)
      (expand-file-name name (pcase system-type
                               ('darwin "/Library/Application Support/GeminiCli")
                               ('windows-nt "C:/ProgramData/gemini-cli")
                               (_ "/etc/gemini-cli")))))

(defun drgnx-agent-config-gemini--root (root)
  "ROOT as a directory name with a trailing slash, or nil."
  (and root (file-name-as-directory (expand-file-name root))))

(defun drgnx-agent-config-gemini--settings-file (scope root)
  "The settings file of SCOPE (user, project, system or defaults); nil without a project for `project'."
  (pcase scope
    ('user (expand-file-name "settings.json" (drgnx-agent-config-home 'gemini)))
    ('project (and root (expand-file-name ".gemini/settings.json" root)))
    ('system (drgnx-agent-config-gemini--system-file "settings.json" "GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH"))
    ('defaults (drgnx-agent-config-gemini--system-file "system-defaults.json" "GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH"))))

(defun drgnx-agent-config-gemini--agents-dir ()
  "The user's .agents directory: gemini looks under $GEMINI_CLI_HOME (not its .gemini) when that is set, else ~."
  (expand-file-name ".agents" (or (drgnx-agent-config--env-dir "GEMINI_CLI_HOME") "~")))

(defun drgnx-agent-config-gemini--skills-dir (scope root)

own login, so the names of its agent (by its command: claude, codex, gemini) are exempt from
`drgnx-agents-scrubbed-env' for it, and only for it.  `AWS_*' and `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS' are not scrubbed
at all."
  :type '(alist :key-type symbol :value-type (repeat string)) :group 'drgnx
  :scope 'global :workspace 'never :agents 'never)

(defun drgnx-agents--command-agent (command)
  "Which agent in `drgnx-agents-own-env' the profile COMMAND (a list) starts, or nil: the first of claude, codex
and gemini that a program or argument's file name contains."
  (let ((words (mapcar #'file-name-nondirectory (seq-filter #'stringp command))))
    (seq-find (lambda (agent) (seq-some (lambda (w) (string-search (symbol-name agent) w)) words))
              (mapcar #'car (default-value 'drgnx-agents-own-env)))))

(defun drgnx-agents--scrub (env &optional profile)
  "ENV (\"NAME=value\"…) followed by a bare-name entry (it unsets the variable) for each of
`drgnx-agents-scrubbed-env' that ENV does not set itself; ENV's own entries come first and so win.  PROFILE (a
profile's options) without an `:ai' route keeps its agent's own names (`drgnx-agents-own-env')."
  (let* ((set (mapcar (lambda (e) (car (split-string e "="))) env))
         (own (and profile (not (plist-get profile :ai))
                   (cdr (assq (drgnx-agents--command-agent (plist-get profile :command))
                              (default-value 'drgnx-agents-own-env))))))
    (append env (seq-remove (lambda (name) (or (member name set) (member name own)))
                            (default-value 'drgnx-agents-scrubbed-env)))))

(defun drgnx-agents--env (s)
  "The environment S's agent gets: its profile's, its provider's — the gateway's address and a token when the hub
can carry it, else the provider's (keys resolved now, never kept) — DRGNX_TASK when S works on a task, and what
`drgnx-agents-env-functions' add; from Emacs's own, the variables in `drgnx-agents-scrubbed-env' are not passed on."
  (drgnx-agents--scrub
   (append (plist-get (cdr (drgnx-agents-profile (drgnx-agent-session-profile s))) :env)
           (when-let* ((profile (cdr (drgnx-agents-profile (drgnx-agent-session-profile s))))
                       (kind (plist-get profile :ai)))

(defun drgnx-build-cli ()
  "Batch entry: `drgnx build' — compile the checkout; exit 1 on errors."
  (let* ((root (file-name-directory (directory-file-name (file-name-directory (locate-library "drgnx-build")))))
         (r (drgnx-build root)))
    (dolist (w (plist-get r :warnings)) (princ (format "warning: %s\n" w)))
    (dolist (e (plist-get r :errors)) (princ (format "error: %s\n" e)))
    (princ (format "drgnx build: %d files compiled, %d warnings, %d errors\n" (plist-get r :compiled)
                   (length (plist-get r :warnings)) (length (plist-get r :errors))))
    (kill-emacs (if (plist-get r :errors) 1 0))))

(provide 'drgnx-build)
